faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Loose Teeth Treatment Near Me

items.question: Can a loose tooth be saved?
items.answer: In many cases, yes. Early diagnosis and appropriate treatment can stabilize loose teeth and prevent tooth loss.

items.question: What causes adult teeth to become loose?
items.answer: Common causes include gum disease, bone loss, trauma, teeth grinding, and severe infection.

items.question: Is loose teeth treatment painful?
items.answer: Most treatments are performed using modern techniques and local anesthesia when needed, ensuring a comfortable experience.

items.question: How long does treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration depends on the severity of the condition and the type of procedure required. Your dentist will provide a personalized treatment timeline.

items.question: What is the cost of loose teeth treatment in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the underlying cause, treatment complexity, and procedures required. A consultation allows us to provide an accurate estimate.

items.question: Can gum disease cause loose teeth?
items.answer: Yes. Advanced gum disease is one of the leading causes of loose teeth because it damages the gums and supporting bone around the teeth.
